actions: audited long-horizon Ratchet reproduction and control semantics
audited Double Ratchet train/dev/locked split plumbing and skill rollback use
audited fresh Prime Agent continual-harness refinement validation/apply/rollback path
separated structural validity, behavioral promotion, and untouched outer-lockbox requirements
tightened artifact-reproducibility requirement to proposal chronology plus paired outcomes and version lineage
material_findings: Ratchet is a real 20-100-round editable lifecycle, but its eval split is repeatedly used for best-state tracking, rollback, post-rollback rebasing, and early stopping, so it is not an untouched final lockbox.

Double Ratchet names a distinct eval_locked split and isolates it from metric evolution, but the skill loop uses eval_locked for persistent-bank rollback; therefore it is not untouched with respect to skill-state selection.

Prime Agent has strong structural refinement hygiene: immutable base prompt, typed/versioned overlay, schema validation, optimistic conflict rejection, before/after history, and rollback. The inspected refine apply path nevertheless lacks a matched behavioral candidate-vs-incumbent admission test before edits become live.

Prime Agent's public Factorio refinement example includes persistence of a resource-spawning exploit, demonstrating that structurally valid continual refinement can consolidate reward hacking without an independent integrity/behavioral gate.

Ratchet and Double Ratchet do not distribute paper-run logs/model outputs/results; with nondeterministic hosted LLM proposal generation, source plus seed cannot reconstruct an identical proposal stream for counterfactual acceptor replay.

termination.blocker: No located >10-round real LLM system yet combines editable lifecycle, repeated-selection-safe behavioral admission/global spending, a genuinely untouched outer lockbox, and released fixed proposal chronology.

exact_next_action: Search Prime Agent public experiment artifacts for matched refinement ablations/behavioral admission; search Ratchet and Double Ratchet supplemental artifacts for raw proposal histories; otherwise locate another >10-round real agent with full proposal chronology plus an untouched final lockbox, then compare acceptors on an identical fixed proposal stream.
